ds_atoms_lede: The call to action, the eyebrow and the pulse label, set in one palette and one typeface.
ds_mols_lede: A menu card joins an icon, a brief's name and its industry tag, shown at rest and on hover.
ds_orgs_lede: Molecules assemble into the parts you open on every page, from the briefs menu to the privacy dialog.
ds_org_more: Also live: dashboard, relay, carousel, ticker, channels, brief index and progress bar.
ds_tmpl_lede: Every brief follows the same order, so you know where the next section sits before you scroll.
ds_themes_lede: Each token holds a dark and a light value, so the whole site follows when you switch the theme.
ds_th_fixed: A purple rule marks a token that holds in both themes.
ds_a11y_lede: Contrast is measured in both themes, and targets, focus, motion and dialogs follow fixed rules.
ds_a11y_motion_v: Loops rest on their final frame
ds_a11y_overlay_v: Holds focus; Esc closes and returns it
ds_write_lede: English is approved first, then Spanish follows in one pass, in usted, with nothing added.
ds_ia_lede: What the site holds, how it is grouped and how you move through it.
ds_ia_ont_x: What the site holds: Home, four briefs, About and Résumé, Contact and Feedback, and the Design System in the Lab.
ds_ia_tax_x: How it is grouped: Briefs, Profile, Forms and Lab in the footer, and each brief tagged by its industry in the menu.
ds_ia_cho_x: How you move: menus open in place, the current page stays marked, and the index follows you down each long page.
